correctness.rationale: Exact finite-N two-cluster invariance gives \(F(x)=x-A\sin x+B(1-\cos x)\). Lower-endpoint sign forces \(A\le1\); a globally unique trigonometric minimizer gives the exact upper-endpoint threshold, including \(A=1\). Its strictly decreasing envelope intersects each physical coupling ray once. One interior repeller separates monotone motions converging to 0 and 2pi. At threshold \(G=G_y=0\), \(G_{yy}=D_c>0\) and \(G_K=-t_c/K_c<0\) give the single square-root slip interval. Taylor expansions give the cusp and weak-lag coefficient, and an independent original-oscillator checker passed 40,916 finite diagnostics. Numerical checks are corroboration, not infinite proof.
